text.en:
The first paragraph of section four of Act Numbered Thirty-six hundred and thirty-nine, entitled
"An Act creating the Bureau of Animal Industry; defining its powers and functions; providing for its
personnel; making appropriations for its organization and operation; changing the name of the Bureau of
Agriculture to Bureau of Plant Industry; and for other purposes," is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Section 4. Terms defined.-'Domestic animals' as herein used, includes horses, mules, asses, cattle, carabaos,
hogs, sheep, goats, dogs, cats, rabbits, deer, fowls, circus and pet animals, and those intended to be used for
show or experimental purposes."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, October 30, 1931.
